lora.base.external.tip: This base has its own licence and is downloaded from its official source. Read the licence before use.
lora.base.tip: The picture model this one is trained on. Use the same one in Canvas.
lora.discard.ask: Discard this run? Temporary versions and samples will be removed. Your photos stay. Type yes to confirm:
lora.drop.duplicate: Almost the same as another photo.
lora.drop.safety: Set aside: this photo can't be used.
lora.drop.small: Too small: the shorter side is under {min_side} px.
lora.drop.unreadable: This file could not be opened as a picture.
lora.err.above_cap: At most {cap} photos can be used.
lora.err.adult_content: Adult content can only be marked for a person who is 18 or older.
lora.err.base_mismatch: This model was trained on a different base model.
lora.err.base_missing: The base model is not installed. Open Manage models.
lora.err.base_runtime: This base model needs newer picture libraries than this version has ({need}).
lora.err.base_restrictive: This base model's licence does not allow sharing trained models. Saving for your own use only.
lora.err.blocked: These photos cannot be used for training.
lora.err.captioner_missing: The description model is not installed. Open Manage models.
lora.err.consent_method: Choose one way of consent: verbal, or an attached release file.
lora.err.disk: Not enough free disk space: {need} GB needed.
lora.err.discard_confirm: Discard was not confirmed. Nothing was removed.
lora.err.diverged: Training went wrong; the last good version is kept. Try a lower learning rate.
lora.err.encoders_stuck: The text encoder did not leave the graphics card ({gb} GB still in use), so training stopped before it could run out of memory. Please report this.
lora.err.export_project: Give the project folder once: the .voxlora package, or --project for the .safetensors file.
lora.err.gate_missing: Models not installed: {ids}. Run: voxprint-forge-cli models fetch --required
lora.err.no_checkpoint: There is no saved version to continue from.
lora.err.no_consent: Confirm consent and that the person is 18 or older.
lora.err.no_gpu: Training needs a supported graphics card.
lora.err.no_name: Enter a name or a stage name.
lora.err.no_release: Attach the release file, or tick Verbal.
lora.err.no_rights: Confirm that you have the right to use these photos.
lora.err.pause_file: A PAUSE file is still in the project folder. Delete it, then start again.
lora.err.refset_blocked: These references cannot be used to build a set.
lora.err.refset_none_kept: Keep at least one picture, or make another round.
lora.err.refset_not_started: Make a first round of pictures.
lora.err.refset_strength: Choose a variation strength from {low} to {high}.
lora.err.refset_teacher_missing: The picture model Z-Image-Turbo is not installed. Install it in Manage models.
lora.err.refset_unreadable: A reference could not be read or is smaller than 512 pixels.
lora.err.subject_attr: Enter a whole number from 18 to 99, and only for a person confirmed as 18 or older.
lora.err.text_encoder: This base model cannot train its text encoder.

lora.err.too_few.one: Add at least {need} more photo to continue.
lora.err.too_few.other: Add at least {need} more photos to continue.

lora.err.vram: Your graphics card has {have} GB; this needs {need} GB. Try the Quick check preset.
lora.expert.alpha.tip: Scales the adapter. Usually equal to rank.
lora.expert.batch.tip: Photos per step. Higher needs more memory.
lora.expert.caption.tip: Which descriptions to train on: long, short or both.
lora.expert.caption_dropout.tip: Share of steps trained without a description. Helps flexibility.
lora.expert.caption_model.tip: The model that writes photo descriptions. It is unloaded before training to free memory.
lora.expert.checkpointing.tip: Saves memory at the cost of speed. Turned on for 16 GB cards.
lora.expert.lr.tip: Learning rate. Too high can break the model; too low learns slowly.
lora.expert.mix_old.tip: When adding photos, share of old photos kept in training so the model does not forget.
lora.expert.precision.tip: Number format on the graphics card. bf16 is the safe default.
lora.expert.preview_every.tip: How often to draw test pictures.
lora.expert.rank.tip: Adapter size. Larger learns more detail, uses more memory and disk.
lora.expert.resolution.tip: Training picture size. Larger keeps detail but uses more memory.
lora.expert.save_every.tip: How often to save an intermediate version.
lora.expert.scheduler.tip: How the learning rate changes over time.
lora.expert.steps.tip: Number of training steps. More steps take longer and can overfit.
lora.kind.tip: Person learns a face and look; object learns a thing; style learns how pictures look.
lora.likeness.tip: How closely the model sticks to your photos. Higher is closer but less flexible.
lora.memory.tip: Matches your graphics card memory. Detected automatically.
lora.menu.export.desc: Save the model as a file with its description.
lora.menu.extend.desc: Teach an existing model more, using new photos.
lora.menu.new.desc: Start a new model from your photos.
lora.photos.add.tip: Add JPG, PNG or WebP photos, or every photo in a folder. You can also drag them here.
lora.photos.count.tip: {rec_low} is the minimum, {rec_high} the maximum. More variety helps more than more photos.
lora.photos.count_expert.tip: Allowed in Expert: {expert_low}–{expert_high} photos. Outside the recommended {rec_low}–{rec_high} results are less predictable.
lora.photos.remove.tip: Remove this photo from training. The file on your disk stays.
lora.prepare.crop.tip: How photos are cropped: centred on the subject, or kept whole.
lora.prepare.dropped.tip: Photos set aside, with the reason. Some photos can't be used, and this cannot be overridden.
lora.prepare.review.tip: Check each crop and description. Click a description to edit it.
lora.preset.balanced.tip: Good quality in reasonable time. Recommended.
lora.preset.best.tip: Slower, more detail. Use it with 20 or more varied photos.
lora.preset.quick.tip: A short run of the whole path: prepare, train, samples, finish and export.
lora.preset.tip: Ready-made settings. Balanced suits most cases.
lora.previews.tip: Show test pictures during training to see how it is going.
lora.progress.caption: Describing photo {n} of {total}

lora.progress.estimate.one: Estimated training time: about {minutes} min for {steps} step
lora.progress.estimate.other: Estimated training time: about {minutes} min for {steps} steps

lora.progress.install: Adding the model to your models

lora.progress.refset_done.one: Round {round} is ready: {shown} picture to review
lora.progress.refset_done.other: Round {round} is ready: {shown} pictures to review

lora.progress.refset_finish.one: Saving the approved set of {count} picture
lora.progress.refset_finish.other: Saving the approved set of {count} pictures

lora.progress.review: Round {round} of {rounds} is ready to review
lora.progress.first_pictures: Step {step} of {steps} · {elapsed} elapsed · first pictures in about {eta}
lora.progress.first_pictures_rate: Step {step} of {steps} · {elapsed} elapsed · first pictures in about {eta} · {seconds} s per picture
lora.status.first_pictures_rate: First pictures in about {eta} ({seconds} s per picture)
lora.reason.caption: the model learns from a picture and its description together
lora.reason.check_photos: to set aside blurry, small or duplicate photos
lora.reason.checkpoint: so you can pick it later or continue after a pause
lora.reason.crop: so the subject fills the training frame
lora.reason.estimate: nothing was trained; this is a dry run
lora.reason.export: the file carries the details you typed in step 2
lora.reason.load_captioner: it writes a description for each photo
lora.reason.preview: so you can see how training is going
lora.reason.review: liked pictures join your photos for the next stage
lora.reason.refset_check: every picture must show consenting adults; pictures that can't be used are not shown
lora.reason.refset_generate: new pictures are drawn from your references
lora.reason.refset_unload: each model is unloaded before the next one starts
lora.reason.safety: every photo must show consenting adults
lora.reason.train: the model is learning your photos
lora.reason.unload_captioner: to free graphics memory for training
lora.result.canvas.tip: Add this model to your models so Canvas lists it with a strength slider.
lora.result.checkpoint.tip: Earlier versions saved during training. An earlier one is sometimes more flexible.
lora.result.extend.tip: Add new photos to improve this model without starting over.
lora.result.save.tip: Save one .safetensors file with its description next to it.
lora.step.photos.desc: Add {rec_low} to {rec_high} photos of what the model should learn: a person, an object or a style.
lora.step.photos.help: Drop photos or a folder here, or press Add. Use sharp photos with different angles, light and backgrounds. Avoid near-duplicates and group shots. 15-20 good photos are usually enough.
lora.step.photos.title: Photos
lora.step.prepare.desc: The app checks every photo, crops it and writes a description for training.
lora.step.prepare.help: This runs by itself. Photos that are blurry, too small, duplicated or can't be used are set aside with a reason. You can review the crops and descriptions before training, and remove any photo.
lora.step.prepare.title: Check and prepare
lora.step.refset.desc: Make a full photo set from 1 to 10 references: the app draws pictures from them, you keep the good ones.
lora.step.refset.help: Press Make pictures. Tick the pictures that look right; unticked ones are left out. The next round starts from the kept pictures and your references. When the set looks exactly as you see it, press This is it, then Next. With your own {rec_low} to {rec_high} photos you can skip this step.
lora.step.refset.title: Build a set
lora.step.result.desc: Try the trained model, save it, or send it to Canvas.
lora.step.result.help: Compare the previews and pick the one you like best. Save writes one file you can keep or share. Open in Canvas adds it to Canvas with a strength slider. To improve it later, use Add more photos.
lora.step.result.title: Result
lora.step.subject.desc: Tell the app what the photos show and confirm you have the right to use them.
lora.step.subject.help: Give a name or a stage name (one is enough). For a person, tick Consent obtained, then tick Verbal or attach a model release, and tick Subject is 18+. The model file records how consent was given and, for a file, only its fingerprint. Once Subject is 18+ is ticked, you can also mark that the photos contain adult content.
lora.step.subject.title: Subject and consent
lora.step.train.desc: Your graphics card teaches the model what is on your photos. Nothing leaves your computer.
lora.step.train.help: Pick a preset and press Start training. You can pause and continue later. Preview pictures appear as training goes, so you can stop early if you like the result.
lora.step.train.title: Train
lora.subject.adult.tip: Required for a person. Every photo must show consenting adults.
lora.subject.adult_content.tip: Optional label that apps such as Canvas can use to sort or filter models.
lora.subject.consent.tip: Required for a person. Then tick Verbal or attach a release file. You are responsible for it.
lora.subject.name.tip: Any name you use for the subject. No documents needed.
lora.subject.note.tip: Optional note about where the photos come from. Stored as you type it.
lora.subject.release.tip: Photo, scan or PDF of a release. For a person it is needed unless Verbal is ticked. It stays in the project folder; the model file only notes that it exists and its fingerprint.
lora.subject.rights_object: I own this object or have the right to use these photos
lora.subject.rights_object.tip: Required for an object. You are responsible for it.
lora.subject.rights_style: I have the right to use these images; the style is not presented as a named living artist's work
lora.subject.rights_style.tip: Required for a style. Do not name a living artist in the name or trigger word.
lora.subject.stage_name.tip: Optional alias. If given, it becomes the trigger word.
lora.subject.trigger.tip: The word that calls this model in a prompt. You can change it.
lora.subject.verbal.tip: Consent was given in words. No file is needed; the model file records the consent as verbal.
lora.train.pause.tip: Pause and save progress. Continue later from the same point.
lora.train.start.tip: Start training on your graphics card. You can pause at any time.
lora.train.stop.tip: Stop now and keep the best checkpoint so far.
lora.warn.count: {count} photos is outside the recommended {rec_low}–{rec_high}; results may be less predictable.
lora.err.no_progress: No training progress has been written yet.
lora.err.preview_device: The preview could not run on the graphics card (devices {devices}). Training is saved; please report this.
lora.err.review_conflict: A picture cannot be liked and disliked at the same time.
lora.err.review_finished: The planned review rounds are done. Finish the run.
lora.err.review_pending: A review is waiting. Mark the pictures, then continue or finish.
lora.err.review_phase: This project is not waiting for a review.
lora.err.review_rounds: Review rounds must be zero or more, and there must be at least one picture per round.
lora.err.review_round_count: The number of review rounds must be from {low} to {high}.
lora.err.first_round_steps: The first round must run for {low} to {high} steps.
lora.err.sample_steps: The number of steps used to draw a picture must be at least 1.
lora.err.review_sample: That picture is not in this review.
lora.err.te_quant_mode: Unknown text encoder quantization "{mode}"; use one of: {modes}.
lora.err.te_quant_missing: Text encoder quantization "{mode}" needs the bitsandbytes package. Install the te-quant extra or use none.
